name: Good Morning, Helix
description: HelixCorp's flagship morning lifestyle broadcast, running continuously since 2186 and now in its fourth host generation, presents two hours of wellness segments, corponation news, augmentation tutorials, and cheerful human-interest stories drawn exclusively from Tier 3-4 HelixCorp residential zones. The hosts — currently the luminous Adaeze Ferreira-Strand and the reassuring Pieter Nakamura-Osei — are themselves product-integrated, their on-air chrome sponsored by HelixCorp augmentation divisions. The show has never aired a segment set on the Shelf and refers to Tier 1-2 content only in the context of cautionary narratives about what happens when citizens make poor loyalty choices.
cultural_impact: The show's relentlessly cheerful aesthetic established the dominant visual grammar of corponation internal media — soft warm lighting, constant low-grade ambient music, and hosts who never visibly age — that has been satirized and imitated across all tiers.
story_hooks: A veteran segment producer leaks to an underground journalist that the show has been running subliminal loyalty-reinforcement patterns in its audio track since 2198.
One of the show's hosts begins inserting coded phrases into their sign-offs — and someone on the Shelf is listening and acting on them.
A runner crew is hired to steal the show's audience behavioral data, which HelixCorp has been quietly selling to Axiom Corp for cross-territory profiling.
